parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested against human carbonic anhydrase I (CHEMBL261). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL261. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Sort the results by ChEMBL identifier in ascending order. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
